If I were the ruler of the world, I would prioritize the following global issues:

1. Dealing with climate change
2. Promoting equality and justice
3. Reducing poverty and improving living standards
4. Encouraging peace and diplomacy
5. Ensuring access to education and healthcare

I would work to address these issues in a way that is both effective and fair, while promoting cooperation and collaboration among people and nations.
